risk_note: RV2 settlement (settlement-plan B2-04p; BR-FUND-04 ⑦, SB5–SB10, BR-FUND-18/20). Batch executor: per-run session advisory lock (two-int key space distinct from order locks) on one reserved connection that carries every statement of the run (batch re-read, CAS, items, completion); per-item transaction calling B2-04m credit with item results guarded by result IS NULL; switches re-read before every item (settle.auto.enabled missing = registry default on; credit.enabled.<platform> missing = off, BR-CALC-03); day-roll checked before and before commit (rollback, batch stays EXECUTING); DONE only when no unprocessed item remains; items ordered by order_key in code.
